BiblicalUsage: Jeremiah says the idols are vanity, the work of errors: in the time of their visitation they shall perish. He says it twice, once against the idols of Judah and once against the idols of Babylon. The word is fraud, delusion: the thing that is not what it claims to be, and will not survive the day God visits it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jeremiah's repetition is deliberate: whether the idol is Judah's or Babylon's, it is vanity, and the day of visitation ends it.
